title: Black Light FTL Uncertainty-Aware Boundary Refinement and Intervention Registry

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.scope: Refine poorly localized operational tidal branch-identity boundaries, preserve covariance/non-smoothness, and hand the earliest plausible ordinary-physics blocker location into family-appropriate intervention reasoning without manufacturing fictional hazard probability or local FTL velocity.

mathematics.boundarySigmaUpper: sigma_f,upper ~= sigma_h,upper/|dh/df| when cross-sample covariance is unavailable
mathematics.reachability: continuous intervention is reachable only when M_D,early>0; equality is not positive clearance

engineeringInterpretation: A nominally localized gamma_min boundary with a broad covariance envelope remains operationally poorly localized.
Uncertainty-driven midpoint insertion is a numerical evidence-density operation, not a fictional danger multiplier.
NONSMOOTH_SCALE and NONSMOOTH_GAP are mathematical states that request more local evidence where possible; they may not be replaced by cosmetically finite uncertainties.
The earliest plausible boundary is a conservative navigation planning location built from the normalized-boundary uncertainty authority.
For continuous families, intervention reachability may use projected route progress. Projected progress is not automatically local hull velocity.
For PRECOMMIT_ENDPOINT and ANCHORED_PORTAL families, continuous corridor intervention distance is not applicable; family timing-margin authorities remain authoritative.

generatorRules: Begin from the existing adaptive route packet; do not duplicate the ordinary gravity, ephemeris, or encounter-time models.
Recompute normalized degeneracy uncertainty on the current sorted sample set at each uncertainty-refinement depth.
Refine BOUNDARY_UNCERTAIN and NONSMOOTH_ENDPOINT intervals while family semantics and resource bounds allow.
Refine BOUNDARY_ESTIMATED intervals when sigma_f exceeds the absolute fraction control or the sigma-to-interval-span control.
Every inserted midpoint must be recomputed through the family encounter-time authority; never interpolate tidal tensors, covariance, gamma, or boundary state.
Numerical convergence requires no operational-boundary interval to remain above the configured uncertainty controls.
Sample/depth ceilings are compute limits, not evidence of safety or convergence.

The earliest plausible boundary uses a declared sigma multiplier and the conservative boundary-fraction upper bound. It is not a physical confidence interval unless a stronger covariance model establishes that interpretation.
A negative or zero continuous intervention distance margin means the modeled intervention chain lacks positive clearance to the conservative boundary.
Do not apply continuous distance-margin equations to PRECOMMIT_ENDPOINT or ANCHORED_PORTAL families.
canonSafeguards: This registry does not establish physical realizability of any FTL family.
Ordinary gravitational branch identity, gamma_min, covariance, and boundary uncertainty cannot prove or create an exotic shear lane, fold corridor, manifold, lattice, phase volume, or gate topology.
A selected simulation family does not establish that a named race, polity, inventor, manufacturer, owner, or vessel uses that technology.
A broad boundary envelope means the ordinary-physics transition is poorly localized; it is unresolved knowledge, not automatically high fictional danger.
A narrow boundary envelope means the ordinary-physics transition is well localized; it is not proof of an exotic hazard.
Missing covariance, source motion, boundary-state evidence, route length, intervention timing, or progress semantics remain missing rather than zero.
Projected progress greater than c does not establish local hull velocity greater than c.
PRECOMMIT and anchored-portal families may not acquire fabricated intermediate route states merely to reuse continuous intervention mathematics.

machineryEmbodimentGuidance.terrestrial-electromechanical: Render nominal and conservative-boundary corridors, covariance envelopes, distance/time margin, independent abort-bus latency, and provenance identifiers.
machineryEmbodimentGuidance.aquatic-electrochemical-hydraulic: Encode localization confidence as pressure/current manifold width and emergency shunt timing rather than requiring Cartesian display conventions.
machineryEmbodimentGuidance.biological-symbiotic: Represent localization confidence as distributed directional salience, uncertainty broadening, and reflex-chain timing while preserving the same mathematical packet underneath.
machineryEmbodimentGuidance.mineral-piezoelectric-photonic: Map branch identity and uncertainty to resonance/polarization-domain separation and phase-coherence margins.
machineryEmbodimentGuidance.gas-giant-pressure-electrostatic: Use volumetric pressure/electrostatic confidence surfaces and regional abort-authority timing.
machineryEmbodimentGuidance.hybrid-salvaged: Preserve sensor ancestry, solver ancestry, control retrofit provenance, and operator representation as distinct fields.
